name_en: Stimulus-preceding negativity (expectancy of feedback or of an action outcome)
name_zh: 刺激前负波（对反馈或动作结果的期待）
reason: Shishkin et al. 2016 (doi 10.3389/fnins.2016.00528) describe the negativity in fixations used for gaze control as similar to the stimulus-preceding negativity of feedback expectation. The registry id MK.SPN is the symmetry-related sustained posterior negativity, so it cannot be used; PER-GAZSEL-001 temporarily uses MK.CNV (anticipation) as the closest marker. Maintainer to decide whether an SPN (expectancy) marker should be added under a non-conflicting id (curator_a, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).

The tactile sensory-attenuation configuration (self- vs externally produced touch; Blakemore, Wolpert & Frith 1998, doi 10.1038/2870) is read out as reduced somatosensory-cortex haemodynamic activity; no registry marker covers somatosensory BOLD (MK.BOLD_posterior_insula is the nearest but is not the reported region). The configuration was not built as MOT-SATT-002 for this reason (curator_b, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).
